name: Deadline
source:
Rebecca Tompson is an investigative reporter on the story of a lifetime, when she accidentally unleashes a shape-shifting monster in her kitchen. 

Now, thanks to an unfortunate slip of the tongue Rebecca will have to use her unexpected companion to uncover the truth behind the supernatural disappearances plaguing her town and write a news story that will expose a thread of corruption and murder leading right to the heart of her city. But if she can’t get the story on her editors desk by dawn, her new companion will be forced to kill her. Though death by magical feline may be the least of her worries.

[from [url=https://screen-savor-studios.itch.io/deadline]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
调查记者丽贝卡·汤普森正在追查一条足以改变职业生涯的新闻，却意外在自家厨房释放了一只能够变形的怪物。

如今，因为一句不幸的失言，丽贝卡必须借助这位意外出现的同伴，揭开小镇接连发生的超自然失踪案真相，写出一篇报道，曝光一条直通城市权力核心的腐败与谋杀链条。但如果天亮之前，她没能把报道交到编辑桌上，这位新同伴就只能杀死她。不过，死于魔法猫科动物之手，也许还算不上她最该担心的事。

[摘自[url=https://screen-savor-studios.itch.io/deadline]itch.io[/url]]
